name: Spring Landscape
material: double album leaf mounted as a handscroll; ink and color on paper
summary: One of the acclaimed "Four Monks" (the other three being Zhu Da, Daoji, and Hongren), Kuncan was known for the rough and rustic style of his landscape paintings.
